supplementary_challenge.selection: all students with an observed weak source-target pair supported by TRAIN
supplementary_challenge.candidate_construction: sample eligible standard edge uniformly, then eligible skill-ID pair and one TRAIN problem per endpoint uniformly; fill remaining slots with existing diverse generator
supplementary_challenge.interpretation: conditional edge ablation on a common graph-constructed candidate set; not end-to-end no-graph, prevalence or pedagogical benefit
supplementary_challenge.design_origin: added after fixed-prefix coverage audit, before challenge policy outputs; original 50-student pilot retained separately

bplus.multiple_ids: separate_states; each weak source ID may supply a soft ranking signal; no AND readiness or pooling
bplus.ranking: weak source with a direct weak target represented in candidates; proximity to fixed TRAIN success-rate target; larger support; stable problem ID

metrics_before_validation.graph_sensitivity: paired selection-change rate curriculum_edges vs no_edges at identical scenario and permutation
metrics_before_validation.order_sensitivity: fraction of students whose selected ID differs across permutations; invalid outputs separately counted
metrics_before_validation.aggregation: each student has equal weight; repeated calls are not independent students
metrics_before_validation.remediation_metric_reference: evaluate selected skill against the full author-proposed graph for BOTH variants; no_edges removes links from policy input only
metrics_before_validation.claims: operational behavior only; no pedagogical benefit, causal mastery prerequisites or learning gain

agent.context_check: compact payload UTF-8 byte guard plus runtime prompt_eval_count; synthetic same-prompt probe at configured and double context before study calls
